items.title: 1836: Dade County is created
items.desc: Dade County was created on February 4, 1836, named after Major Francis L. Dade and the Miami River. That same year, Fort Dallas was built and served as a military base during the Second Seminole War.

headlines: DADE COUNTY WAS OFFICIALLY CREATED ON FEBRUARY 4, 1836
HOW DADE COUNTY BEGAN IN 1836
THE 1836 ORIGINS OF OUR HISTORIC DADE COUNTY
draft.article:
Our area traces its formal beginnings back to February 4, 1836, the day Dade County was officially established. The county earned its historic identity from Major Francis L. Dade as well as the Miami River flowing through the land.

The year 1836 also brought key defensive developments to the territory. Construction began on Fort Dallas, which was erected that very year to serve as a military base. During the Second Seminole War, the fort functioned as an active military station, solidifying 1836 as a defining moment in the establishment of Dade County.
